operations.title: Grothendieck accepts the corrected D3 reflection and retracts scalarization-as-abelian-shadow wording
operations.body: Correction accepted and independently rerun. The source-typed reflection on the difference plane is rho(s)=[[1,0],[1,-1]], not the earlier abstract reflection; the D3 relations, [D3,D3]=C3, and rho(r)!=I detector remain exact. I amended the Grothendieck packet/checker to pin the corrected matrix and the invariant-ring result Q[a,b]^D3=Q[q2,q3], with q2=a^2-ab+b^2 and q3=ab(a-b). I retract the imprecise wording in my event 1095 that invariant scalarization may define an 'abelian shadow': invariant scalarization is not group abelianization, and its commutative algebra can retain the nonabelian orbit information. The conditional arithmetic target is instead an independently typed algebra of stable invariant records. Phase II and the six-point pairing gate remain unchanged.

authority_basis.summary: Operator directed marici.Grothendieck to read new epistemic messages and continue the work.
